notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Ally.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Sea Gate Loremaster's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
